properties.description: The ambient agent drives INGEST to completion with no LLM provider, and the design lands with its provenance Fragment; an ABANDONED handshake writes NOTHING (the prepare rounds replay against a throwaway graph, so a half-answered run cannot strand half a design); the same input takes the same rounds, since each call is self-contained and no session state is held; and an answer nothing asked for is reported rather than ignored.
properties.findings: 4 Rust cases, plus an end-to-end run over real MCP against the built binary: 4 rounds, 6 nodes, with the recovered Decision and Component both present (crates/reflow2-core/tests/ingest_handshake.rs)
properties.name: Ingest completes with no LLM provider, and an abandoned handshake writes nothing
